angularDiameterSource: No angular diameter is measured: this is the radius Herczeg & Hillenbrand (2014) derive, 1.26 solar radii, at the Gaia distance.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 source 151374202498079872: parallax 7.4936 mas, inverted to 133.4473 pc with no zero-point correction.
radiusSource: Radius 1.26 solar radii from Herczeg & Hillenbrand (2014, ApJ 786, 97; VizieR J/ApJ/786/97, table14), from the star's luminosity and spectral-type temperature at their adopted 140 pc; a derived radius, not a measured disc. 876,582 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Temperature 3600 +/- 150 K from Xuan et al. (2024; arXiv:2405.13128), Table 1. GM from 0.64 +/- 0.04 solar masses (Kraus & Hillenbrand 2009), the host mass Bowler et al. (2020) adopt for the orbit of DH Tau b placed here, times the JPL solar GM; Herczeg & Hillenbrand give 0.41 from other evolutionary tracks. presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; no spin axis is measured on the sky.
effectiveTemperatureSource: 3600 +/- 150 K: Xuan et al. (2024), Table 1, https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.13128
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/dh-tau.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.044, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of DH Tau (pscomppars): spectral type M0.5, from Patience et al. 2012 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012A%26A...540A..85P/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of DH Tau (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.21153, from Zhou et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...783L..17Z/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of DH Tau (pscomppars): age 0.001 Gyr, from Patience et al. 2012 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012A%26A...540A..85P/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/AJ/168/234/table10 (Flares & flaring stars from TESS & machine learning), column Prot: 4.67167 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

rotationPeriodsCatalogued.source: VizieR J/AJ/168/234/table10 (Flares & flaring stars from TESS & machine learning), column Prot: 4.67167 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, V* DH Tau: projected rotation speed 7.1 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2025ApJ...978...42H)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (1.26 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.520. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius. The star's disc is not resolved; its color is a blackbody at the published temperature.
